title: Scout Runtime Skill Output
description: Defines the standardized runtime output produced by a Scout skill invocation. A Skill Output records what a skill generated, the inputs and contracts used, execution details, structured payloads, artifacts, citations, validation results, quality readiness, exceptions, and downstream consumption information. It does not represent the final execution result.
